title: Saving and retrieving a hash index
description: You can follow a key through hashing, dictionary storage and file serialization.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: HashIndex starts with an empty dictionary and remembers its file name. You load a saved dictionary when that file exists.
add hashes the supplied key, assigns its value in the dictionary and saves the dictionary with pickle. Each add calls _save.

steps.question: How does get locate the value stored by add?
steps.answer: It applies the same hash transformation to the key and looks up that digest in the dictionary.

steps.description: You add key1 with value1 and retrieve it using key1. The supplied run prints value1.
